notes: Both coders found the same two university-layer documents. Stance: both gave delegates for the Academic Guidelines; for the Security and Risk Policy A said restrict and B delegates, resolved as restrict because the policy sets its own limits (authorized uses only, approved tools only, no sensitive data in public tools) and defers only academic use. Main unit disagreements: (1) policy_type for principle and scope clauses (P56 vs P61), resolved to P61 when the sentence says what the document covers; (2) tier sentences (Open Use, Use with Disclosure, Use with Oversight, Prohibited Use) coded P59/P47/P74/P50 by one coder and P05 by the other, resolved to P05 for all four tiers; (3) writing-assistance sentences coded P18 by A (prose vs code), resolved to P15 because no prose-versus-code distinction is made; data analysis and visualization resolved to UNCOVERED; (4) phase: standing rules coded general vs during-work or before-course, resolved by whether the rule is tied to doing work (during-work) or applies to all use (general); syllabus statement duty resolved to course-start; (5) modality informs vs must for definitions and responsibility sentences, resolved as informs for definitions and must for accountability duties; (6) unit_stance permit, require, restrict or encourage for duties and sanctions, resolved as neutral when the sentence does not take a position on AI use; bans that apply only to unapproved or public tools resolved as restrict, not prohibit; (7) Security policy: P56 vs P65 vs P73 vs P40 for governance, documentation and audit duties, resolved to UNCOVERED where no type fits (documentation and records, exception approval) and to P53 for bias assessment and monitoring. Only-A units: 13 found, 12 kept (purpose bullets, definition, committee duty, permitted-use bullets, encryption control, scope sentence, acknowledgment and OEA clauses); 1 dropped as an exact repeat of the earlier labeling rule. Only-B units: 18, all kept (scope and definition sentences, security controls, approval and incident-process rules, instructor Open Use items). Two sentences holding two rules each were split and one Permitted Uses bullet added by the reconciler, so the final file has 165 units. Agreement shares use raw coder codes over matched units.
